name: 030-voice-clone-design-warm
description: VoiceDesign profile with warm=1.0. Creates the profile then uses it for /v1/audio/speech synthesis. Asserts the design_params round-trip through the profile store and the resulting audio passes the same envelope check as 030-voice-clone-base.

request_body.input: Hello, this is a warm test voice.

ref_outputs.notes: design_params is currently passed through opaquely (see `VoiceProfile::design_params` in nv_tts and `oapi::voice_profiles::handle_create`). The placeholder assertion is round-trip: the profile we POST must come back from GET with identical design_params. Once a VoiceDesign conditioning head is wired the audio envelope assertion in step 2 becomes the canonical check.
